author: PlaysByBrulesRules
body:
For the 200-224 stretch I’d prioritize trying to start saving up tower shards. Towers become much harder when you hit 225 and the celestial classes and weapons that require tower shards will be very important when adjusting to T10 difficulty. 

If you can go in with 300k shards you’re golden.
